cards.card_text: With an uplifted hand, God swears to that generation in the wilderness that He will not bring them into the ___ He had given them.
cards.verse_text: Moreover, with an uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land that I had given them—a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands—

cards.card_text: Because the children keep rejecting His statutes and fixing their eyes on their fathers' idols, God swears an oath to them in the wilderness with an uplifted hand.
cards.verse_text: However, with an uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them throughout the lands.
